purpose: Bounded method evidence, not recipe findings or publication authorization.

sources.access: Full relevant OSU page text read in web search extraction; two direct opens failed (timeout/internal error).
sources.claim: Cut similar-size pieces; smaller pieces cook faster. Arrange a single layer, roast until tender with browned edges, and turn during cooking for even browning. Refrigerate leftovers within two hours.
sources.application: Sheet-pan vegetable roasting; supports geometry-aware timing and both tenderness/browning checks.
sources.exclusion: Does not prove different vegetables of equal size finish together; example times are not a universal schedule.
